items.title: 4.9 Dawa ki paidawar aur khuraak (dosage) mein stoichiometry ki ahmiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.9, printed page 91.

blocks.text: Dawa ki darkar khuraak (dose) tayyar karte waqt mareez mein matloob asar paida karne ke liye active ingredient (faal juz) ki behtareen miqdar zaroori hai. Stoichiometry dawa ki tayyari (synthesis) ki durustagi yaqeeni banati hai: koi bhi inhiraf na-mukammal reaction ya ghair-react shuda reactants ya by-products se aloodgi ka sabab ban sakta hai. Stoichiometry chemists ko dawaein banane ke liye kimiyai reactions par theek qaboo rakhne deti hai aur un ki efficiency, asar aur mehfooz istemal yaqeeni banati hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek tablet mein ek reactant balanced muadle ki zaroorat se thora kam dala jata hai. Is chapter ke khayalat se batayein ke product mein kya kharabi ho sakti hai.
blocks.explanation: Woh reactant limiting reactant ban jata hai, to irade se kam active ingredient banta hai aur khuraak kam hoti hai. Doosra reactant excess mein bach kar product ko ghair-react shuda madde se alooda karta hai, jo khud nuqsan-deh ho sakta hai. Sirf theek stoichiometric miqdarein khalis active ingredient ki durust miqdar deti hain.

items: Durust khuraak ke liye active ingredient ki behtareen miqdar chahiye; stoichiometry dawa ki tayyari durust rakhti hai, na-mukammal reactions aur ghair-react shuda reactants ya by-products se aloodgi se bachate hue.
